NC House, veto override, 2018-12-19: yea (tally 72–40); census gate: none.

Listed among the many co-sponsors (not a primary sponsor) of HB 589 (VIVA, Voter Information Verification Act). The filed bill text says it requires voters to provide photo identification before voting and creates a voter information verification advisory board. Date is the date of the filed bill text.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (vote 758)
findings.note: Voted aye on second reading. The ratified bill includes a requirement that a voter registration application affirmatively state US citizenship (a missing answer triggers a notice and a sworn statement), and a process to remove voters flagged as possibly non-citizens by a federal database. Passed 66 to 47. Later vetoed by the governor on 2026-08-17.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, M11 Concur (vote 801)
findings.note: Voted aye on the House concurrence vote with the Senate version of HB 958 (citizenship statement on voter registration; removal process for voters flagged as possibly non-citizens). Passed 62 to 47. Vetoed by the governor on 2026-08-17 per the bill page; no override found on that page.
